metadata.name: JLPT N5 kanji import data
metadata.source_note: PDF is image-based; text extraction only exposes watermark text. Data was normalized from the visible Soumatome N5 kanji structure and completed with standard N5 kanji readings, Sino-Vietnamese readings, meanings, stroke counts, and vocabulary examples.
notes: The JSON follows the simple UI flow: jlpt_levels -> kanji_topics -> kanji_characters -> kanji_words.
kanji_topics.name is Japanese-first. kanji_topics.name_vi is a Vietnamese subtitle for the UI.
source_week, source_day, and source_page_start preserve the Soumatome-style lesson origin.
word uses kanji where applicable; reading stores kana/furigana reading.
example_* fields are generated learning examples for every kanji word.
